How old is Danny Valencia?

Danny Valencia is 41 years old.

When was Danny Valencia born?

Danny Valencia was born on September 19, 1984.

Danny Valencia was born in Miami, FL.

Danny Valencia is 6-2 (188 cm) tall.

Danny Valencia played 9 seasons.

Danny Valencia has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

Danny Valencia was a Third Baseman, First Baseman and Outfielder.

How many hits did Danny Valencia have?

Danny Valencia had 795 hits over his career.

Danny Valencia had 96 home runs over his career.

Danny Valencia had a .268 average over his career.

How many teams has Danny Valencia played for?

Danny Valencia played for 7 teams; the Baltimore Orioles, Boston Red Sox, Kansas City Royals, Minnesota Twins, Oakland Athletics, Seattle Mariners and Toronto Blue Jays.

When did Danny Valencia retire?

Danny Valencia last played in 2018.
